climate: Summers are close to rainless. Vines draw on water stored in the soil, or on irrigation, but disease is rare.

blurb.text: A Central Coast AVA along the San Benito River near Hollister, with a moderate climate cooled by Pacific breezes. It contains Paicines, Cienega Valley and Lime Kiln Valley. About 23 grape varieties grow here, and it once supplied most grapes for Almadén Vineyards.
